text: するどいカマで　えものを　きりさき　いきのねを　とめる。

structure.jp: えものを　きりさき
structure.en: it tears its prey apart, and

structure.jp: いきのねを　とめる。

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut down to its short form (きりさきます without ます) joins to the next action like 'and'. It is the written-style version of the て form. きりさき = 'tears apart, and'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing tells what is used to do the action. するどいカマで = 'with its sharp scythes'.
